propositions: Add mcp autodeploy target implementing ADR 0079 blue-green pointer-swap to track origin/main without killing in-flight certified operations (eliminates bug 7b4a)
Memory pre-check aborts deploy if MemAvailable < MCP_MEM_MIN_MB (default 1024 MB) on t4g.large 8 GiB, emitting AUTODEPLOY_MCP_MEM_ABORT and recording backoff without starting second container

Start new container on free A/B host port (8092 or 8093), health-check /health within MCP_HEALTH_TIMEOUT (default 120s), atomically flip nginx /mcp/ upstream via dotfile temp + atomic rename, then gracefully retire old container with docker stop --time 1260 (SIGTERM self-drain) never docker rm -f

Graceful retire runs backgrounded so autodeploy tick never waits on drain; exited containers reaped each tick; if managed count exceeds MCP_RELEASES_CAP (default 3) or both ports bound, emit AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP and backoff without forcing

Change detection triggers mcp only on MCP_PATHS changes (src/rebar, Dockerfile.mcp, docker-compose.yml, uv.lock, pyproject.toml); shared changes (src/rebar, docker-compose.yml) independently trigger both mcp and review-bot targets
Publish rebar/host:mcp_retire_cap and rebar/host:mcp_mem_abort metrics via observability.sh marker-delta mechanism routed to CloudWatch alarms → SNS topic (no direct SNS from autodeploy.sh)
